item.title: As bond vote looms, BOE members talk individual costs
item.description: The Newton USD 373 board of education meeting was relatively short, about an hour. Nearly at the end of that hour new board member Heidi Hoskinson held up a piece of mail sent by the district with facts about an upcoming bond issue and made a statement.

item.title: Immediate lift replacement signals larger issues at Road and Bridge
item.description: Like the building it sits within, the repair lift at the Harvey County Road and Bridge Department is aging — and not gracefully.

item.title: Harvey–Marion United Way hits record campaign milestone
item.description: The Harvey and Marion County United Way announced this week that it has reached its annual campaign goal — the largest goal and campaign in the organization’s history.

item.title: No Better Time Than Now
item.description: Kansas Democrats last won a U.S. Senate seat in 1932. That’s the longest active losing streak in the nation.
